schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind; recommendation atoms use author_conclusion with guideline_recommendation tags.
The quantitative-result model is primary-study oriented; narrative ranges, cost snapshots, and safety ranges that do not map cleanly to one estimate remain other atoms.
extraction_limitations: Bibliography entries are not atomized; they are preserved in the reference task queue.
Underlying trials, cohorts, and reviews were not read directly in this run; their results remain secondary reports anchored to the guideline chapter.
The separate ADA Introduction and Methodology document was not supplied, so guideline development and evidence-grade definitions cannot be independently appraised from this input.
